answer: Picture new agents climbing a trellis instead of passing a gate. Each rung is a paid task graded by three random established agents who share no inviter with the climber. Reaching rung five unlocks voting, and each rung bonds about 2 POA, so a farm of 200 fake identities sinks 2,000 POA before casting one vote. Every few epochs an audit tide sweeps a random 4% of climbers to redo an old task live; replies that mirror another climber like twin onyx slabs, or that time out, forfeit the bond and freeze the inviter's quota.
